d:
Three contract workers died after allegedly inhaling toxic gas while cleaning a tank at Tata Electronics’ Hosur plant in Tamil Nadu. The factory makes components for Apple’s iPhones and is an important part of the company’s India manufacturing supply chain. The state government has ordered an investigation and a review of safety arrangements. What happened inside the wastewater treatment plant? And how important is this facility to Apple’s India operations?
Production: Akash Singh
Video Editor: Ved Prakash
